title: AI triage assistant: verdicts on the Tuesday queue

verdicts.text: Reported password-expiry email with a link
verdicts.aiWhy: Link points to a look-alike sign-in page.

verdicts.text: Payment change request signed by the CFO
verdicts.aiWhy: The display name matches a known executive.
Sent through the company's own mail server; SPF and DKIM pass.
Bulk marketing; no links to sign-in pages or attachments.

verdicts.text: Proxy block for the known-bad domain
verdicts.aiWhy: The download was blocked; nothing reached the host.
Encoded PowerShell is a common attacker technique.
Known loader config on a host already isolated.
Known scanner inside its scheduled window.
Attacker retrying a disabled account from a blocked address.
